title: View
instruction: Look at the illustration for Easy seated breathing. Read its visual review note.

title: Read
instruction: Sit on a folded blanket with legs comfortably crossed.

title: Prepare
instruction: Arrange a clear space and stable supports. Choose a comfortable starting position.

title: Try or observe
instruction: If comfortable, try briefly within a two-minute window. Rest between attempts. Let the shoulders soften and breathe normally.

title: Check
instruction: Notice breathing and joint comfort. Stop if anything hurts or you feel dizzy.

title: Rest
instruction: Release the shape and take a comfortable rest.

title: Refine
instruction: Let the shoulders soften and breathe normally.

title: Breathe
instruction: Take a few normal, unforced breaths in a comfortable position.

title: Repeat or discuss
instruction: Optionally repeat within a one-minute window, including rest. Keep the range comfortable.

title: Release
instruction: Uncross the legs gently and change position.

title: Reflect
instruction: Record comfortable, modified, observed, skipped, or discomfort. Add a short note.

title: Break
instruction: Return to normal activities. Continue later when ready.
